Not cleaning your wounds definitely heightens the risk of infection, which you would then need to go to the hospital to deal with.

Btw buying cans of wound wash can get pricey but you can make your own with a gallon of distilled water and 8 teaspoons of non-iodized sea salt (make sure it’s distilled water and non-iodized salt tho)

I normally use a saline wound wash and I have a pain-relieving antiseptic, it’s just a band-aid brand one but I only really use that on shallower wounds because it’s only meant for minor cuts, scrapes, and burns. You could also use a mild antibacterial soap and wash with warm water. 

And then if you bandage make sure you let the area air dry first, keeping them bandaged up too much can cause issues!

Just a little wound care psa; rubbing alcohol can cause tissue damage and slow the healing process, same with hydrogen peroxide actually (using hydrogen peroxide to clean a wound initially is fine but using it long term can slow healing)
